stem: On 5 October 2025, Voltmarkt's lead report shows SQL to customer conversion of 4% for the September cohort and 30% for the March cohort. What is the most likely reason the September figure is so low?

options.text: Many September deals are still open, and an open lead is not lost
September's leads were of far lower quality than the leads from March
The March cohort counts each customer twice, once per stage
SQL to customer conversion should divide by all leads, not SQLs
